login.lead: See your own moderation record in {server}: your warnings, warning stage, any active ban or mute, your cases and your appeals.
login.withAccount: Log in with a Mewvo account
login.note: Mewvo asks Discord only who you are (the identify permission): no email, no servers, nothing else. You only ever see your own record. The login lasts one hour.
login.signup: No Mewvo account yet? [Create one]({href}) to log in with a username and password.
login.appealLead: Log in with Discord to appeal a punishment from any server that uses Mewvo. You only ever see your own cases.

record.title: My record
record.lead: Your moderation record in {server}, logged in as **{username}**. Only you can see this.
record.warningsNote: Counted warnings at your level. Warnings do not expire.
record.noAppeals: You have not filed any appeals.
record.appealHintInvite: Appeal from the appeal panel in Discord: [join the support server]({invite}) and press **Appeal** with the case code. Nothing can be appealed from this page.
record.appealHint: Appeal from the appeal panel in Discord with the case code. Nothing can be appealed from this page.
record.appealHintWeb: Appeal a case from any server on [My appeals]({href}). You can also appeal from the appeal panel in Discord with the case code.

slowDown.title: Slow down
slowDown.message: Too many requests from your address. Wait a minute and try again.

loginCancelled.title: Login cancelled
loginCancelled.message: You did not authorize the login.

loginExpired.title: Login expired
loginExpired.message: This login link is invalid, expired or already used.

loginFailed.title: Login failed
loginFailed.message: Discord did not confirm the login. Try again.

noUser.title: Login failed
noUser.message: Discord did not return a user.

linkOtherBrowser.title: Not linked
linkOtherBrowser.message: Log in to your Mewvo account in this browser first, then link Discord again.

recordUnavailable.title: Record unavailable
recordUnavailable.message: Your record could not be loaded because the database is not responding. This does not mean your record is clean: try again in a few minutes.

downloadLogin.title: Log in first
downloadLogin.message: Log in with Discord to download your data.

downloadLoginAccount.title: Log in first
downloadLoginAccount.message: Log in to download your data.

downloadUnavailable.title: Download unavailable
downloadUnavailable.message: Your data could not be collected because the database is not responding. Try again in a few minutes.

logoutNotAllowed.title: Not allowed
logoutNotAllowed.message: The logout request did not come from this page.

tryLater.title: Try again later
tryLater.message: This page could not be loaded because the database is not responding. Nothing was changed.

caseNotFound.title: Case not found
caseNotFound.message: That case code was not found for your account. Check the code in your DM.

appealNotAllowed.title: Not allowed
appealNotAllowed.message: The appeal did not come from this page. Open the appeal page again and send it from there.

appealsUnavailable.title: Appeals unavailable
appealsUnavailable.message: Your appeals could not be loaded because the database is not responding. Nothing was changed: try again in a few minutes.

next.afterOne: The one after it would mean an automatic ban ({ban}).

afterMore.one: {count} more after it would mean an automatic ban ({ban}).
afterMore.other: {count} more after it would mean an automatic ban ({ban}).

next.limit: It would reach the warning limit: an automatic ban ({ban}, warning stage {level} of 3).

appeals.title: My appeals
appeals.lead: Your cases in every server that uses Mewvo, logged in as **{username}**. Only you can see this.
appeals.whoDecides: Only the staff of the server that gave you a case decide its appeal. Mewvo does not decide appeals for other servers.
appeals.noneAppealable: You have no cases that can be appealed right now.
appeals.noAppeals: You have not filed any appeals.
appeals.claimed: Pending: a staff member is looking at it
appeals.sent: Your appeal for {code} was sent to the staff of {server}. The decision shows up here.
appeals.dmNote: When staff decide, Mewvo also tells you by DM if Discord allows it. The decision is always shown on this page.

appealForm.title: Appeal {code}
appealForm.lead: Your appeal goes to the staff of **{server}**. They decide it, not Mewvo.
appealForm.punishedHint: In your own words, up to {max} characters.
appealForm.reasonHint: At least {min} and up to {max} characters.
appealForm.note: Staff see your answers, your Discord name and this case. One appeal per case at a time; after a denied appeal you have to wait before you can appeal again.
appealForm.notAppealable: This case cannot be appealed right now:

errors.punished: Tell staff why you got punished.
errors.reason: Explain in at least {min} characters why it should be lifted.
errors.refused: Your appeal was not sent: this case cannot be appealed right now. It may already have a pending appeal, be in the waiting time after a denial, or have ended.
errors.tooMany: You sent too many appeals. Try again in an hour.
